source: Native AWS boto3 regional clients, DynamoDBProbe recording/lifecycle conventions

findings.scope: One owned version-2019.11.21 MREC pair; A=us-east-1, B=us-east-2. Eight competing-write trials on distinct keys. All observations are bounded samples, not a generalized last-writer guarantee.

knownSuccessfulNoops.observed: Same-value PutItem and UpdateItem succeeded and ALL_OLD returned the unchanged baseline item. DeleteItem on a never-written key succeeded without Attributes in its ALL_OLD response.
knownSuccessfulNoops.publicStreams: Both regional streams contained the baseline INSERT and later control-marker INSERT. Neither contained another record for known-noop, and neither contained any record for known-missing, through the final stream read window.
knownSuccessfulNoops.internalReplication: Not observable from these public Streams results; absence of a public record is not proof that no internal replication operation exists.

competingWrites.sameValuePut: Three successful B distinct-value writes followed promptly by A baseline PutItem returned A's baseline ALL_OLD, establishing genuine local same-value no-ops before B's value had reached A. All four convergence snapshots in both regions contained B's distinct value for all three keys.
competingWrites.missingDelete: Three successful B inserts followed promptly by A DeleteItem returned no Attributes with ALL_OLD, establishing genuine local missing-key no-ops before B's insert had reached A. All four convergence snapshots in both regions contained B's inserted value for all three keys.
competingWrites.existingDeleteControls: Two B distinct-value writes followed by A DeleteItem returned baseline ALL_OLD, not B's value, and were actual local deletions rather than no-ops. All four convergence snapshots in both regions showed both keys absent.
competingWrites.clientTiming: Recorded gap from B response completion to A request start was 0.000006-0.000009 seconds. A request durations were 0.099723-0.105053 seconds; B request durations were 0.110215-0.122473 seconds. These client timings are not server commit timestamps.
competingWrites.convergenceWindow: The first snapshot began 1.014-17.593 seconds after each trial's A response; the final snapshot ended 15.971-32.550 seconds after it. Per-operation timestamps and all four regional snapshot responses are retained.
competingWrites.interpretationLimit: This sample establishes concrete no-op/conflict outcomes, not the internal replication representation, native timestamp assignment, or behavior for every possible timing. A same-deployment global logical sequence remains an emulator design choice.

streamViewAdmission.observed: After all item/Stream observations, enabling KEYS_ONLY and then enabling NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES each returned ValidationException: Table already has an enabled stream. Both regional settings remained enabled NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES. Disabling separately returned ValidationException: Disabling Stream is not allowed for a Global Table replica.
streamViewAdmission.interpretationLimit: KEYS_ONLY was not admitted, so the NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES request was an unchanged-view request, not a successful restoration. The enabled-stream error does not by itself establish that every possible global-table creation path mandates this public view type.

findings.cleanup: Owned peer removed with UpdateTable, then source deleted. Native ResourceNotFoundException verified us-east-2 absence at sequence 408 and us-east-1 absence at sequence 415. No IAM or service-linked-role resources were modified.

documentation.contract: PutItem or UpdateItem changing no data does not write a public Stream record; per-item ordering.
2019.11.21 defaults to MREC; asynchronous replication, latest internal timestamp per-item conflict resolution; replication may combine changes so replica public Streams can differ.

experiment.timing: UTC client request start/end and monotonic duration; not server commit timestamps. Conflict pairs use persistent regional SDK connections, no shell launch or evidence disk flush between B response and A request.

limitations: Public Streams observations do not reveal internal replication records or whether a local no-op produces an internal replicated write.
Client request order and timings do not expose native internal timestamps or establish a general last-writer guarantee.
ALL_OLD establishes the local preimage returned by the successful operation, not the state at an unobserved remote replica.
Finite observation windows cannot prove permanent absence of a delayed record or permanent convergence.
A same-deployment global logical sequence is an emulator design choice, not native evidence.
